description: Official Ovia Labs documentation: the whitepaper, roadmap and documentation for Ovia Protect, Ovia Network and the proposed OVIA Token.

components.name: Ovia Labs
components.today: An independent, early-stage initiative. Brand, website and documentation are prepared; the new website and these docs are not yet deployed.

components.name: Ovia Protect
components.today: Requirements are being written. A first feasibility test (PRD-010) has been completed. No product code has been released.

components.name: Ovia Network
components.today: A research direction. There is no specification, code, network or verifier set.

components.name: OVIA Token
components.today: An exploratory concept. No token, contract, supply, allocation or launch plan exists.

components.name: Developer API and SDK
components.today: No public API, SDK or integration interface exists or has been specified.

revisions.changes: Initial documentation release: whitepaper v0.1 (12 chapters), Ovia Protect, Ovia Network and OVIA Token documentation, roadmap, developer overview and resources.
